name: Confusion Effect
slug: A spell effect that leaves its victim confused and unable to act meaningfully.
description: A confusion effect caused by a spell that disrupts a creature's ability to think and act coherently.

log.summary: Gerk was affected by a confusion spell after failing a Wisdom saving throw. The effect left him incoherent and unable to move or take meaningful actions.
